verdicts.reason: A: the one-line headline runs almost edge to edge with only about 28px of side margin, and the vertical spacing is uneven: there is a big gap between the headline and the subcopy, then the subcopy sits jammed against the CTA. The bottom of the canvas is also left as dead space. B: the text block is grouped more tightly and consistently, but the headline wraps to leave 'fizz' alone on the second line. Both share the same flaws: the wordmark sits on the overlapping decorative circles, and the empty band at the bottom makes the layout feel top-heavy.
